summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine share purchases under forward contracts to cover obligations from long-term incentive plans. The company acquired 2,835,849 ordinary shares between August 18 and 27, 2026, with daily purchases from August 24-27 totaling 1,476,362 shares at average prices between €17.25 and €17.46. Purchases were executed on Euronext, CBOE, DXE, and Turquoise. This is a standard issuer buyback for employee compensation, not a special situation. Watch for continued periodic updates until the 5.5 million share target is reached.
